title: Open-Source AI Toolkit Reaches 1.0 Milestone
summary: After two years of community development, a popular open-source machine learning toolkit ships its first stable release with improved documentation and a simpler API.

title: Chipmaker Unveils Low-Power Processor for Edge Devices
summary: A new processor design promises double the battery life for smart sensors and wearables while keeping on-device inference fast.

title: Cloud Providers Expand Regional Data Centers
summary: Major cloud vendors announce new regions across Asia and Africa to reduce latency and meet data residency requirements.

title: Cybersecurity Report Highlights Rise in Phishing Attacks
summary: An annual security report finds phishing attempts increased sharply and urges organisations to adopt multi-factor authentication.

title: Central Bank Holds Interest Rates Steady
summary: Policymakers keep the benchmark rate unchanged, citing stable growth and easing price pressures across major sectors.

title: Global Stocks Rally on Strong Earnings
summary: Equity indices climb as quarterly results from banks and retailers beat analyst expectations.

title: Startup Funding Rebounds in First Quarter
summary: Venture investment rises for the second consecutive quarter, led by climate technology and healthcare start-ups.

title: Inflation Cools as Energy Prices Ease
summary: Consumer price growth slows to its lowest level in a year, driven mainly by lower fuel and electricity costs.

title: Underdogs Clinch Championship in Overtime Thriller
summary: A last-second basket sends the final into overtime, where the underdog squad completes a stunning comeback.

title: Marathon Record Broken at City Run
summary: A distance runner shaves almost a minute off the course record in near-perfect weather conditions.

title: Young Striker Signs Record Transfer Deal
summary: A 20-year-old forward joins a top European club in the most expensive transfer of the season.

title: National Cricket Squad Announced for Overseas Tour
summary: Selectors name a balanced squad with three uncapped players for the upcoming five-match series.

title: Study Links Daily Walking to Better Heart Health
summary: Researchers following 30,000 adults find that a brisk 30-minute walk each day is associated with a lower risk of heart disease.

title: New Vaccine Trial Shows Promising Results
summary: Phase 2 trial data indicate a strong immune response with mild side effects, paving the way for larger studies.

title: Sleep Experts Recommend Consistent Bedtimes
summary: A review of sleep studies concludes that regular sleep schedules improve mood and concentration more than extra weekend rest.

title: Hospitals Pilot AI-Assisted Diagnostic Scans
summary: Three regional hospitals begin trials of software that flags suspicious areas on scans for radiologists to review.

title: Telescope Captures Detailed Image of Distant Galaxy Cluster
summary: Astronomers release a deep-field image revealing hundreds of faint galaxies bound together by gravity.

title: Researchers Develop Biodegradable Battery Material
summary: A university team creates an electrode material that breaks down safely in soil within weeks, opening the door to greener electronics.

title: Deep-Sea Expedition Discovers New Species
summary: A research vessel documents more than a dozen previously unknown organisms living near hydrothermal vents.

title: Climate Model Improves Regional Rainfall Forecasts
summary: An updated climate model cuts forecast errors for monsoon rainfall, helping farmers plan planting seasons.
